description: How important a TmToolbarButton is when its TmToolbar runs out of room (Overflow = Menu). An overflow rank only: buttons render in written order. Generalises the DocumentEditor ToolbarItemPriority.

values.name: Primary
values.description: The default. Stays on the toolbar until every Secondary button has moved into the More menu.

values.name: Secondary
values.description: Moves into the More menu before any Primary button does.

values.name: OverflowOnly
values.description: Always lives in the More menu and is never rendered on the toolbar itself.

values.name: Pinned
values.description: Never moves into the More menu: stays on the bar at every width, measured as fixed width (the trailing Save / primary call to action). Additive - appended after OverflowOnly so existing values keep their numbers.
